title: Split components/topic-steering-workspace.tsx (18k lines): pure helpers, hooks, chrome, views
description:
components/topic-steering-workspace.tsx is 18,077 lines and 765 KB with about 110 components, 310 helpers, 202 useState and 118 effects, three generateClient<Schema>() instances, a 400-line Markdown parser and a Biblicus command-plan builder. lib/newsroom-section-routing.ts:1 and two route files import NewsDeskTab from it, inverting the dependency.

Do this in five PRs, in order of risk: (1) pure helpers to lib/ with unit tests: Markdown parser (:10542-10951, or delete it in favour of Streamdown if that dependency is kept), analysis command plan (:13132-13640), reference normalisers (:14012-14560, :16408-17200), section model (:13664-13860), category tree (:16668-16860); move NewsDeskTab and NewsDeskSelection to lib/newsroom-nav.ts; (2) hooks: dashboard state (:760-1310) as one reducer hydrated once, replacing the 40 useState slots and the ~12 copy-props-to-state effects at :1040-1110; reference realtime subscription (:1315-1470); useReferenceMetadataFields (:14335); fix useMediaQuery (:546-558) with useSyncExternalStore so SSR does not flip layouts after hydration; (3) shared chrome: list-detail shell with the gsap split pane (:8473-9060), data and card grids (:9062-9453), expander (:3994-4160), and replace the bespoke action menu (:8689-8760) with the base-ui DropdownMenu already imported; (4) one file per desk view (Overview :3295, Administration :4329, Desks :5752, Topics :6019, Concepts :6343, References :6488, Insights :6980, Messages :7339, Search :10287, Assignments :12478, proposal/category-tree :15473-16400, corpus panels :17576-17914); (5) detail rails (semantic :9453, reference :10995-11854, message :11638). While in there: mark loaded sections only in .then and keep a loading/loaded/error tri-state (:1186-1231); create the two Amplify clients once in news-desk-taxonomy-client.ts.

Done when: the composition root is under ~700 lines, each extracted lib module has a unit test, and no route or lib file imports from a client component.

Source: full code review of develop @ e9b1923 on 2026-10-17 (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/f01a3c9f-7fad-4df2-8a15-ac6c27cc83ed). Branch from origin/develop, name the branch after this issue, open a PR into develop, and record branch, PR link and verification in a comment here before closing.
